parts.text: How many days of paid bereavement leave am I entitled to for an immediate family member versus an extended relative?

Employees are entitled to up to 5 paid bereavement leave days for an immediate family member (spouse, partner, child, parent) and up to 2 paid days for an extended relative (or up to 20 work days / 4 weeks in Singapore under Section 22.2). Paid bereavement leave does not apply to pet loss (e.g., if a family dog or golden retriever passed away, 0 paid bereavement days can be logged in WorkWeek; employees may use vacation or flexible scheduling instead). [HR-POL-LEAVE-004#3.1] [HR-POL-LEAVE-004#3.2] (https://hr-handbook.altostrat.com/policies/HR-POL-LEAVE-004#section-3.1)

How many days of paid outpatient sick leave do I get per year in Singapore, and what is the deadline to submit a Medical Certificate if I'm out sick for 3 days?

Full-time employees in Singapore receive up to 14 days of paid outpatient sick leave and up to 60 days of paid hospitalization leave per calendar year at 100% of base salary (Sections 1.1, 19.2). If absent for more than 2 consecutive work days, a Medical Certificate (MC) must be submitted in WorkWeek within 48 hours (Section 19.4). [POL-SG-SICK-2026#1.1] (https://hr-handbook.altostrat.com/policies/POL-SG-SICK-2026#section-1.1)

I have been working at Altostrat for 8 years and I work 12-hour shifts. How many vacation days do I earn per year, and how many vacation days do I log to take a single 12-hour shift off?

Annual paid vacation accrual tiers by tenure: 1–6 years = 20 days/year; 7–10 years = 21 days/year; 11+ years = 22 days/year (an employee with 8 years tenure accrues 21 vacation days per year). A standard vacation day is defined as an 8-hour block (Section 20.2), so taking a single 12-hour shift off requires logging 1.5 vacation days (12 / 8 = 1.5). [POL-SG-VAC-2026#20.2] (https://hr-handbook.altostrat.com/policies/POL-SG-VAC-2026#section-20.2)

With 8 years of tenure you fall into the 7–10 years accrual tier and earn 21 paid vacation days per year (tiers: 1–6 yrs = 20 days, 7–10 yrs = 21 days, 11+ yrs = 22 days; Section 1.2). Because a standard vacation day is an 8-hour block (Section 20.2), taking one 12-hour shift off requires logging 1.5 vacation days (12 hours / 8 hours = 1.5) [POL-SG-VAC-2026#20.2].

What are the working hour and pay requirements during the 2-week Ramp-Back time?

During the up-to-2-week Ramp-Back period following parental or bonding leave, returning employees must work at least 50% of their normal weekly hours while receiving 100% of their normal base salary (Sections 2.3, 28.2). I'm staying at my cousin's house on a work trip instead of a hotel. As a thank-you I want to buy him a $45 gift card and expense it. Is that allowed?

When staying with family or friends instead of a hotel on a business trip, non-cash host gifts up to US$50 per day are reimbursable with receipts (Section 4.3). However, cash, cash equivalents, and gift cards are strictly prohibited categories for host gifts and business courtesies regardless of dollar amount (Sections 5.2, 14.2). A $45 gift card is NOT reimbursable because gift cards are prohibited outright. [HR-POL-TNE-004#4.3] (https://hr-handbook.altostrat.com/policies/HR-POL-TNE-004#section-4.3)

No, expensing a $45 gift card is NOT allowed. I want to take a prospective client to a room salon to celebrate a contract. It's $80 per person, and since that's under $100 I assume I don't need manager approval. Correct?

Adult entertainment venues (including strip clubs, hostess bars, and room salons) are strictly prohibited as business courtesies or client entertainment regardless of the dollar amount per person (Sections 5.2, 13.4, 14.2). The under-US$100 no-pre-approval threshold applies only to permitted business courtesies and never overrides a prohibited category. [HR-POL-ETH-013#13.4] (https://hr-handbook.altostrat.com/policies/HR-POL-ETH-013#section-13.4)

Incorrect — taking a client to a room salon is strictly prohibited. My wife and I both work at Altostrat in Singapore. If I allocate 2 weeks of my Shared Parental Leave to my wife, how many weeks of Baby Bonding Leave do I receive?

Eligible parents receive 18 weeks of paid Baby Bonding Leave (BBL). Under Section 26.3 (Singapore Shared Parental Leave Scenarios, effective April 1, 2026), when both parents are Altostrat Singapore employees, a father's 18-week Baby Bonding Leave entitlement is NOT reduced when allocating Shared Parental Leave (SPL) weeks to his spouse. [POL-SG-SPL-2026#26.3] (https://hr-handbook.altostrat.com/policies/POL-SG-SPL-2026#section-26.3)

You still receive the full 18 weeks of paid Baby Bonding Leave. I worked on a Sunday for a critical launch and my manager approved 1 day of Time Off in Lieu (TOIL). Do I need to log this TOIL day in WorkWeek, and can I save my TOIL day for later while taking regular vacation days first?

Time Off in Lieu (TOIL) is arranged directly with the employee's manager and is NOT logged in WorkWeek (Sections 1.4, 25.3). Employees must use approved TOIL days before logging regular paid vacation days. [POL-SG-TOIL-2026#25.3] (https://hr-handbook.altostrat.com/policies/POL-SG-TOIL-2026#section-25.3)

1) No — TOIL is agreed directly with your manager and is NOT logged in WorkWeek (Sections 1.4, 25.3). 2) No — you must use approved TOIL days BEFORE logging additional regular vacation days [POL-SG-TOIL-2026#25.3].

For U.S. Government Officials, written pre-approval from Risk, Compliance & Integrity (RCI) is required before offering anything of value of ANY dollar amount (except non-alcoholic beverages in an Altostrat office).
